description: Links for a listing map: a US aerial photo of the site as a PNG (USGS National Map imagery, public domain, any width from 100 m to 5 km), a USGS topo map PNG, and Google Maps and OpenStreetMap links. In the UK only the map links are returned for now. Instant, no outside calls.

address.description: Street address with town and ZIP or postcode, e.g. "7090 State Highway 80, Cooperstown, NY 13326" or "Ambleside LA22 9BB". Not needed when lat and lon are given.

country.description: Optional hint for the address lookup.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lon instead of address).

pixels.description: Image width in pixels. Default 1200, max 2400.

width_m.description: Ground width of the image in metres. Default 500, 100 to 5000.

name: map_image
title: Map and aerial image links
